title: 2nd Annual Roger Murray lecture series: A Conversation with Richard Thaler and Tano Santos
summary: The discussion highlights how specific companies have achieved success through the strategic application of choice architecture. It argues that offering a manageable selection, as seen with Amazon, enables users to find products efficiently, while Netflix similarly leverages this principle to allow users to watch content easily. For an investor, the core argument is that these firms' competitive advantages are rooted in their ability to simplify user decision-making processes.
